summary: This note is a short Wikipedia-style biography entry for actor Jason Lewis. It covers his early television appearance on Beverly Hills, 90210 in 1997 and his most prominent role, Smith Jerrod on Sex and the City, including his return in both Sex and the City films.
one_line: Jason Lewis is an American actor known for playing Smith Jerrod on Sex and the City and its two follow-up films.
key_facts: Jason Lewis appeared on Beverly Hills, 90210 in 1997.
On Beverly Hills, 90210, Lewis played a love interest of the character Valerie.
Valerie was played by Tiffani-Amber Thiessen, as written in the note.
Lewis's most prominent role to date was in Sex and the City.
In Sex and the City, Jason Lewis was a recurring cast member in the show's final season.
Lewis played Smith Jerrod, a waiter turned emerging young actor, in Sex and the City.
Smith Jerrod was the one man whose sincerity got to the character Samantha.
Jason Lewis reprised the role of Smith Jerrod in Sex and the City: The Movie, released in 2008.
Jason Lewis also reprised the role of Smith Jerrod in the 2010 sequel to Sex and the City: The Movie.
The note describes Sex and the City: The Movie as a 2008 film.
